format: little-endian float32 xyz unit vectors; 0,0,0 means direction unknown
order: original LVX2 packet and point order, no spatial resampling
loop: replays same five-second sample; not an infinitely non-repetitive physical scanner
limitations: Includes source-recording invalid slots and mm range quantisation; no reconstruction of missing ray angles. New geometry is raycast only along known measured directions. Not individual-device calibration.
